properties.name: --text-align-v
properties.description: Vertical text alignment within the container (Puree extension)

properties.name: --text-x
properties.description: Horizontal text position offset in pixels (Puree extension)

properties.name: --text-y
properties.description: Vertical text position offset in pixels (Puree extension)

properties.name: --img-align-h
properties.description: Horizontal image alignment within the container (Puree extension)

properties.name: --img-align-v
properties.description: Vertical image alignment within the container (Puree extension)

properties.name: scrollbar-width
properties.description: Width of the scrollbar track. Puree supports keywords and px values.

properties.name: scrollbar-color
properties.description: Shorthand for scrollbar thumb and track colors: <thumb-color> <track-color>

properties.name: scrollbar-thumb-color
properties.description: Color of the scrollbar thumb (draggable part). Puree extension.

properties.name: scrollbar-track-color
properties.description: Color of the scrollbar track (background). Puree extension.

properties.name: aspect-ratio
properties.description: Maintain aspect ratio for images and containers (Puree uses boolean values)

properties.name: overflow-wrap
properties.description: Whether to break words that overflow the container

values.name: normal
values.description: Only break at allowed break points

properties.name: word-break
properties.description: How words should break at end of line

properties.name: text-shadow
properties.description: Shadow effect for text: offset-x offset-y [blur-radius] [color]
